exclusions.chess-best-move: Representation mismatch for the current text-only agent interface.
exclusions.gcode-to-text: Geometry reconstruction is outside this small text-only execution-loop calibration.
exclusions.adaptive-rejection-sampler: Repeated pre-agent dependency bootstrap failures and large observed setup/runtime.
exclusions.configure-git-webserver: Coupled multi-service setup obscures execution-loop changes in a small calibration budget.

limitations: The calibrated12 cohort differs from stress16; scores cannot be compared directly across those experiments.
Using gpt-5.4 for proposals is a new optimizer hypothesis, not demonstrated improvement or an isolated model ablation.
The original baseline is re-evaluated; no old evaluation score or candidate source is reused as new evidence.
Small fixed task sets and paired confirmation do not establish broad benchmark generalization.
The workflow freezes the final source before its own holdout; holdout results are not optimizer feedback.
Holdout runs baseline first; identical final source reuses its attempts, so this is not an independent repetition.
Model cost uses uncached token-price estimates; local Docker dollars are unpriced.
Measured runtime includes setup, verification, cleanup and amd64 emulation on aarch64.
Pinned verifier completion is operational evidence, not tamper-proof adversarial grading.
One paid controller is required; advisory exclusion covers only cooperating review scripts.
These task roles have been evaluated before. Held-back tasks remain excluded from optimizer prompts, but this is repeated development validation, not a previously unseen generalization test.
Compatible rejected-proposal feedback diagnostics are inherited as optimizer memory; all baseline, candidate, confirmation and final evaluation scores require new trials.
